text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day when I couldn't catch 
up to Epiphaneia as she ran off—she has 
contacted me only once.

A LINE message with just an "◎" probably 
meant 'Don't worry.' Considering how 
headstrong and reckless she is, it was 
amazing she even remembered to text at 
all, but—
choice_data_list: (I haven't seen her once since then...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—If you're looking for Epi-san, she just 
left a moment ago...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um, are you alright? You look pretty 
tired...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Epi-san is safe. There are eyewitness 
reports from various people, too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There are times she's holed up at 
Ruler-san's place, and other times—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Speaking up actively during class, acting 
like a perfect model student—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...She was also witnessed digging 
something up.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...So please, don't trouble your heart 
over it. I'll be keeping a proper eye on 
things too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! It looks like they're fully 
planning to take part in the summer 
training camp!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There were signs of training equipment 
being maintained... and it looked like 
they were stocking up on things like water 
guns, too!

With the skill-honing summer training camp 
just days away... I reached out to 
Epiphaneia once more to let her know I was 
looking forward to seeing her.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Phew... —Time for the final check.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"O 'Voice of Destiny'... Please, give me 
the push I need...!"

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Boxer
text_block_list.text:
"...Then let's go, Epiphaneia. —Here we 
come!!"

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Boxer
text_block_list.text: Hah!! Yah! Hmph!! Ooooooohhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
(――Right! Left! Up! Down! Down! One more 
step right! Spin around to the left!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Just like that, dodge it just like 
that, Epiphaneia!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: “—No way, I knew it... That's my voice!!”

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Boxer
text_block_list.text:
You dodged every single one, so what's 
with all that "No, stop" nonsense...

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Boxer
text_block_list.text:
Well, but looks like the fog has cleared. 
So, think you can walk that path?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whether we can make it down this path... 
Well...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...At times like these, she just won't 
listen. Still—the results are in.

And with racing hearts, the day of the 
summer training camp finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Epi! Glad to see you're doing well...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Sorry for making you worry!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I thought this was something I had 
to verify on my own. I wanted... to do it 
by myself."
choice_data_list: So, what did you find out?
So, what did you find out?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Is that "voice of destiny" really my own 
voice?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Comparing my own feelings to the moments I 
hear the voice of destiny...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I tried out so many different things! And 
I kept at it until I was completely 
satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah. To put it bluntly—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The voice of destiny... right now, it's 
completely my own voice!

The voice of destiny was one of the 
reasons she could run with absolute 
confidence. I thought she would be deeply 
bewildered after losing it, but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It seems that now, she only can't hear 
when making important decisions!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to everyday things, I can 
still hear it just like before, but... 
that voice definitely belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You've been pushing me forward for so 
long, I'll probably react out of reflex 
for a while!
choice_data_list:
...You look like a weight's been lifted 
off your shoulders.

...You look like a weight's been lifted 
off your shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah!! All the gloominess is gone now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And so, let's get down to training! I'll 
work extra hard to make up for worrying 
you!
Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whew... *pant*...!!

Epiphaneia's running lacks its usual 
power. Her sharp closing burst is 
completely gone...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! How was that, Trainer?
choice_data_list: That run wasn't like Epi at all...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What?! That's weird... I'm going for one 
more run!

—However, no matter how many times we 
tried, the result was the same. All the 
explosive power had completely vanished 
from Epiphaneia's running...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Why is that!?!?
choice_data_list:
Hmm, she looked like she lacked 
confidence, but...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You don't have confidence...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What kind of state is that even supposed 
to be!? I don't get it! I'm amazing, 
aren't I?!

She seems unaware of it herself, but... 
having lost that absolute blessing known 
as the voice of destiny, she seems to have 
lost confidence in her running.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Confidence... How do you even gain 
confidence?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, so I just gotta keep on winning!? 
...A 1000-person mock race!!"
choice_data_list: Let's calm down for a second...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Wait, do I start with my right foot? Or my 
left... !?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah, my head is spinning! I hate this, 
I want to go back to the way I was—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Will you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Something is waiting for me...!

Epiphaneia suddenly dashed off, just as 
she always did. However, unlike before... 
it was not by her own will, but almost as 
if she were being guided by something.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Over here... There's something over here—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's beautiful, isn't it...? Do you like 
this place too, F-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Because it's quiet.

There, two Umamusume were enjoying a 
relaxing time.

The moment they noticed Epiphaneia's 
slowly approaching footsteps—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: This is...—

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: —...My chest, it hurts...

For a moment, as if time had stopped... 
the three of them stared at each other.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's destiny.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's destiny!! I felt a powerful 
destiny... connecting us!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind!! You're tagging 
along for my training!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely the best choice! I mean, 
those two felt destiny calling to me too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If I'm with the two of you, I feel like... 
I can push myself even harder! Isn't that 
right, Trainer!?

Right now, Epiphaneia has fallen into an 
unprecedented slump. However... the two of 
them might be able to have a positive 
influence on her...!
choice_data_list:
I know this is sudden, but what do you two 
think?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I would... love to, absolutely! Epi-senpai 
is among the top tier right now... It 
would be a wonderful opportunity to hone 
my skills.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Once again, I'm Daring Tact. I look 
forward to working with you!"

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: —I am Efforia.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
With my upcoming debut in mind, please let 
me learn what it means to be strong on the 
front lines, too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness, thank you!! All 
riiiiiight!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll teach you how I run too! 
Looking forward to working with you—Tact, 
F!

With two juniors joining in— a summer 
training camp where anything could happen 
began.
